name: Jiangsu Eazytec Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Eazytec Co., Ltd. engages in the cloud computing equipment core firmware products in China and internationally. It offers basic input output system (BIOS) and baseboard management controller (BMC) firmware products; and government and enterprise, and Internet of Things cloud services. It serves CPU manufacturers, computing equipment manufacturers, government, and enterprises. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Yixing, China.
